cumleler: Why is 500 hertz usually skipped in school screening?
Screening tests 1000, 2000 and 4000 hertz in each ear.
Schools are not booths; room noise masks low frequencies most.
So no response at 500 hertz may reflect noise, not loss.
It was also unreliable for fluid; ASHA dropped it in 1997.
For the middle ear, tympanometry is the better tool.
